lines.note: A viewer runs the slots command with a bet. The bet is taken, the reels roll, and the game settles on the spot: two or more matching slots win, all of them alike is the jackpot, anything else loses the bet. The slots go out as one message and the result as the next.

lines.what: spins for 500, within the minimum and maximum.
also half, third, quarter and random.

lines.note: A trigger of your own can pass the argument free=1 for a single free spin; Free mode on the Game page makes every spin free.

The bet × the payout % of the tier (2, 3, 4 or 5 alike, or the jackpot) × the emote's weight ÷ 100, and never less than the bet. A low weight comes up often and pays little, a high one is rare and pays a lot; which weights play is set on the Game page, the weights themselves on the Emotes page.

With the jackpot pool on, every lost bet goes into a pool per platform, and a jackpot with a bet at or above 'Bet to win the pool' takes the pool on top. Twitch subscribers and VIPs can get a boost; viewers on the Addicted list get a cut.
'What really comes out' on the Game page shows the odds your settings give, and 'Try a spin' plays one with the exact chat message, without sending or saving anything.

On Twitch a channel point reward can start the spin instead of the command (Access page): the reward's price is the bet, or a typed amount, a fixed amount, or nothing at all. YouTube and Kick keep the chat command. A redemption that can't end in a spin is refunded while it is still in the request queue.
